name: artcraft_upload_voice_sample
description: Upload a local audio file into a voice training dataset. Reads a local file and sends it to ArtCraft; requires confirm: true. File must be inside the user's home directory (or ARTCRAFT_MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS), an audio type, and <= 100 MB.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this local file may be read and uploaded.

file_path.description: Local path to an audio file inside an allowed directory
